name: cashflow
title: Cash flow
description: Where the household's cash came from and went over a window (default: the last twelve months), as a cash flow statement; positive is cash arriving. view=summary: per period: operating_in, operating_out, investing, financing, vehicles (all retirement, education and health plans together), net_cash_flow. flows: per period and node (section, class, group); one plan or the mortgage is flows with a class filter (Mortgage sits under financing). sankey: the diagram's edges. transactions: the lines. coverage: per account and period, how far the statement can be trusted (read status first). projection: one row per month ahead (default: the horizon after this month; period monthly, quarterly or annual): investment_income, principal_returned and vehicles_income as the income projection expects them, other_income, operating_out and vehicles as trailing monthly averages, debt_service (each mortgage to its maturity), net and quality. Example: {view: "flows", from: "2025", to: "2025", level: "class"}.

account.description: Keep rows whose account name, id or nickname contains this (case-insensitive).

class.description: Keep classes whose label contains this (e.g. "Mortgage", "Retirement").

currency.description: Output currency, e.g. USD or CHF. Default: the configured one.

filter.description: Conditions, all of which hold: ["value > 1000", "date >= 2025-07", "category not in Rent, Groceries"].

from.description: Window start; snaps to the unit's start.

group.description: Keep only groups whose label contains this text.

investing.description: whole (default): investing as one node; class: one node per asset class.

level.description: Node grain of flows and sankey: section, class or group (default group).

limit.description: Most rows to return (default: as many as fit).

maturing.description: projection: what a maturing principal earns: cash, idle or roll (net then leaves principal_returned out). Default cash.

max_chars.description: Most characters the result may take (default 16000); the page ends at a row boundary and the last line says how to get the rest.

period.description: Bucket size (default total; monthly on projection, which takes no total). Not for sankey.

rates.description: projection: constant or forward floating rates. Default constant.

search.description: Keep rows with this text in any cell.

section.description: Keep one section: operating_in, operating_out, investing, financing, vehicles, cash.

shift.description: projection: parallel shift of the floating rates in basis points (default 0).

sort.description: Column to sort by; "-" for descending. "-value": the main money column, largest first whatever the sign.

source.description: Keep this source id only (e.g. "schwab"); a comma list keeps several.

to.description: Window end; snaps to the unit's end. Default today unless the tool says otherwise.
